purpose: Exploratory training-side mechanism diagnostic after common-route closure; not a new RUL model or confirmatory method result
registration_stage: Fixed specification recorded before this D1 execution; earlier response-model outcomes and descriptive condition diagnostics were already observed
outer_rule: For each of six development engines exclude that outer engine entirely; crossfit each of the remaining five engines by training on the other four and predicting that one inner engine
physical_scaler: Mean/std ddof0 of all sampled rows from the four training engines only; each of 18 columns; std floor1e-6

static_model.features: 15 columns: 1; W_i for i=0..3; W_i*W_j for 0<=i<=j<4, in nested i,j order; W uses training-four physical scaling

empirical_residual_scale: Training-four in-sample static residual std ddof0 per sensor, floor1e-6; this is empirical residual scale, not noise or uncertainty

dynamic_model.raw_features: Static quadratic15 including constant1; backward deltaW4 with flight-first row0; W_i*deltaW_j16 in nested i,j order; position and position^2
dynamic_model.position: k/511 for k=0..511; flight-local normalized sampling position, not seconds
dynamic_model.delta: W[k]-W[k-1] on the 512-point normalized-position grid; first row0; not divided by a physical time increment and not a per-second rate
dynamic_model.feature_scaler: Each of the 37 raw columns mean/std ddof0 fitted on four training engines; std floor1e-6; constant1 becomes0
dynamic_model.design: Prepend a separate unpenalized intercept to the 37 standardized columns; 38 stored coefficients, including the zero constant column; effective36 nonconstant features plus intercept
dynamic_model.target: Static training-four residual in standardized sensor coordinates, without empirical-scale division

metrics.residual_std_raw_std_ratio: For each inner engine and sensor: std of all residual rows / std of all standardized observed sensor rows, both ddof0
metrics.age_correlations: Pearson correlation across inner-engine flights between observed cycle and flight means of raw sensor, static residual, and residual divided by its fixed training-four empirical scale
metrics.correlation_identity: The last two correlations are algebraically identical for a positive fixed per-sensor scale; equality is a software check, not evidence of new information
metrics.dynamic_error_reduction: 1 - mean((inner_residual - dynamic_prediction)^2) / mean(inner_residual^2); reference is exactly the residual zero-predictor, not a fitted inner-engine mean
metrics.undefined: Zero-variance correlation or zero denominator yields null; undefined values block the associated gate rather than being silently dropped

scale_suppression.aggregation: All120 crossfit inner-engine x14 sensor rows; also report each subset and each outer fold; dependent repeated appearances are not independent samples

dynamic_omission.aggregation: Median of30 crossfit engine x14 sensor rows within each subset; then count subsets meeting threshold

gates.interpretation: These are descriptive mechanism gates. Dynamic gain suggests omission by a static conditional model; it does not establish causality, health identification, generalizable RUL improvement, or module novelty

failure_branch: Preserve partial files and error/elapsed evidence; do not relax thresholds, change feature forms, tune ridge, launch RUL training, or select a replacement module from these diagnostics
dependence_limit: The120 diagnostics reuse engines and overlapping train-four sets across outer folds; they are not120 independent samples; no p-values, independence-based CI, or significance claims
